results.title: `?fields=` naming a field that does not exist
results.evidence: `?fields=invented_field` answers 2 empty object(s) with 200 and no refusal. The only thing distinguishing it from a listing of rows that genuinely have no values is `projected_to: ['invented_field']` — which says what was asked for, not that nothing matched it. A client mapping a mistyped field name gets a page of empty rows and a success, and the register looks empty
